title: PFPD Bounded Targeted Fine-Tuning Specification
objective: Lift per-class Recall for Class 1 (Construction: currently 76.92%) and Class 2 (Road Accident / Obstacle: currently 72.09% - 75.90%) to >= 85.0% while maintaining >= 90.0% Precision and zero regression on Potholes (Class 0: 93.6% P / 100% R), retaining the 29 FPS physical Raspberry Pi 5 runtime intact.

weak_cases_diagnostics.root_cause: Severe representation deficit in training data (<2% of Class 2). Class 2 is overwhelmingly vehicle collisions (car bodies, glass, tires). Bark/log texture blends with asphalt; foliage creates high textural noise.
weak_cases_diagnostics.target_augmentation: Horizontal/diagonal log synthesis + green foliage background contrast

weak_cases_diagnostics.root_cause: Grey rock aggregate matches weathered asphalt; scale varies from 20cm rocks to scree.
weak_cases_diagnostics.target_augmentation: Shadow-casting rock contrast + gravel negative mining

weak_cases_diagnostics.root_cause: Occupies <16x16 pixels; features smoothed out by stride-32 downsampling in P5.
weak_cases_diagnostics.target_augmentation: Multi-scale crop augmentation (scale 0.5 to 1.5) forcing small-scale detection

weak_cases_diagnostics.root_cause: Perspective foreshortening reduces vertical height to <4 pixels.
weak_cases_diagnostics.target_augmentation: Perspective ellipse augmentation + low-confidence temporal tracking

candidate_sources.source_name: Roadside Natural Obstacles & Fallen Tree Dataset
candidate_sources.verification_protocol: Zero MD5/pHash overlap with 150 benchmark images or test split
Strict dHash Hamming distance > 10 from all evaluation sets
Manual bbox annotation of diamond/rectangular warning signs only

candidate_sources.source_name: Pothole Negative Mining Hard Control Set
candidate_sources.purpose: Anchor pothole precision and prevent catastrophic forgetting of void features

verification_gates_and_rollback.gate_1_pothole_regression: Pothole recall must remain >= 95.0% and precision >= 90.0%
verification_gates_and_rollback.gate_4_pi5_fps: Physical Pi 5 throughput must sustain >= 28.0 FPS at 384x384 INT8 (>= 24 FPS hard limit)
verification_gates_and_rollback.gate_5_pi5_thermals: Core temperature < 68.0°C and throttled=0x0 throughout 10-minute run
verification_gates_and_rollback.rollback_trigger: If any gate is violated, immediately rollback to unified_yolo11n_best.pt. All baseline specialist weights (pothole_yolo11s, construction_yolo11s, accident_yolo11s) remain permanently locked in models/.
